description: Meet Gloria State Representative Gloria Johnson has dedicated her life to serving Tennesseans, fighting for justice and standing tall for all who have been left out, left behind, or left without a voice. Early on, Gloria's family instilled in her the drive to put people first, no matter the cost.…
